## Names

<a id="spawn_actor"></a>
### [`spawn_actor`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L20) `$0B8E`

*routine*

Spawn (initialise) actor X. Input: X = actor (0 Bruce, 1 Yamo, 2 Ninja), A = type in bits 7-6 (0 Bruce, $40 Ninja, $80 Yamo). Called by reset_play_state (Bruce), spawn_yamo and spawn_ninja. - actor_flags = A OR 1 (bit 0 = active); temp_y = type 0-2. - Records the actor as owner of its sprite slots (set_sprite_slot_owner) with the collision codes of the type from actor_collision_code_first / actor_collision_code_second (also kept in actor_collision_code_a/b). - Resets the actor fields: actor_state, actor_timer, actor_step_delay = 0; actor_joy_dir = $0F (no direction); actor_fire = 1 (not pressed); actor_contact = 1; actor_facing = 1 (right); actor_pose and actor_frame_a = 2, actor_pose_b and actor_frame_b = 3; actor_energy = $24; current_actor = X. - Position (actor_x, actor_y): Bruce, and every actor in the demo, use start point A of the room (spawn_a_x/y). An enemy that followed Bruce from the last room (enemy_follow_x nonzero) takes the saved position and energy. Otherwise Yamo/Ninja take start point A or B (spawn_b_x/y): the side byte of the room (yamo_spawn_side; for the Ninja ninja_spawn_side decides only the zero test) zero gives a random side; else 3 times in 4 its sign picks the side (plus = A, minus = B) and 1 time in 4 the side is random. - Sets the sprite pointers, the sprite positions (X*2 with bit 8 in MSIGX, Y + 29) of the actor's main and overlay sprites and enables them.

- **Called from:** [`reset_play_state`](play_init.md#reset_play_state) [`$082A`](../../../src/play_init.asm#L110), [`spawn_yamo`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_yamo) [`$0CE5`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L214), [`spawn_ninja`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_ninja) [`$0DFD`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L401)
- **Calls:** [`set_sprite_slot_owner`](actor_spawn.md#set_sprite_slot_owner), [`random_byte`](interrupt_entry.md#random_byte)
- **Reads:** [`temp_y`](../memory-map.md#temp_y), [`game_mode`](../memory-map.md#game_mode), [`room`](../memory-map.md#room), [`current_actor`](../memory-map.md#current_actor), [`sprite_buffer_select`](actor_sprites.md#sprite_buffer_select), [`MSIGX`](../memory-map.md#MSIGX), [`SPENA`](../memory-map.md#SPENA)

<a id="spawn_yamo"></a>
### [`spawn_yamo`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L203) `$0CD5`

*routine*

Spawn Yamo (actor 1, type $80). Plays the entry sound (play_enemy_spawn_sound), stores the protection key prot_key_yamo XOR prot_key_yamo_pair in protection_result, calls spawn_actor and sets Yamo's fields: actor_state = $10, actor_pose/actor_pose_b = $2A/$2B, actor_frame_a/actor_frame_b = $6C/$6D, actor_timer = $0A, actor_energy at most $14. While protection_result is zero (a cracked key), actor_play_step_sound increments the low bytes of the two operands below. Called by update_yamo_spawn.

- **Called from:** [`update_yamo_spawn`](actor_spawn.md#update_yamo_spawn) [`$0D1B`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L246)
- **Calls:** [`play_enemy_spawn_sound`](game_setup.md#play_enemy_spawn_sound), [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor)
- **Reads:** [`prot_key_yamo`](protection_key_page.md#prot_key_yamo), [`prot_key_yamo_pair`](protection_key_page.md#prot_key_yamo_pair), [`actor_energy+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_energy)
- **Writes:** [`protection_result`](room_enemy_tables.md#protection_result), [`actor_state+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_state), [`actor_pose+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_pose), [`actor_pose_b+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_pose_b), [`actor_frame_a+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_frame_a), [`actor_frame_b+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_frame_b), [`actor_timer+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_timer), [`actor_energy+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_energy)

<a id="update_yamo_spawn"></a>
### [`update_yamo_spawn`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L238) `$0D0F`

*routine*

Yamo spawn timer (main loop, every pass when the room has enemies). When yamo_spawn_timer is zero and Yamo is not active: spawn Yamo and load the next delay from yamo_respawn_delay[room] ($30 when player 2 controls Yamo). get_room_time_level then halves the delay after 6400 frames in the room (room_time high byte >= $19) and sets 3 after 8192 frames (>= $20) or when game_loop_count is nonzero.

- **Called from:** [`main_loop`](game_main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1BF8`](../../../src/game_main_loop.asm#L49)
- **Calls:** [`spawn_yamo`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_yamo), [`get_room_time_level`](game_setup.md#get_room_time_level)
- **Reads:** [`yamo_spawn_timer`](../memory-map.md#yamo_spawn_timer), [`actor_flags+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_flags), [`room`](../memory-map.md#room), [`option_yamo_player2`](options_and_patterns.md#option_yamo_player2), [`game_loop_count`](../memory-map.md#game_loop_count)
- **Writes:** [`yamo_spawn_timer`](../memory-map.md#yamo_spawn_timer)
- **Refers to:** [`yamo_respawn_delay`](room_enemy_tables.md#yamo_respawn_delay)

<a id="reset_spawn_timer"></a>
### [`reset_spawn_timer`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L274) `$0D42`

*routine*

Reload the spawn timer of actor X without spawning: X = 1 Yamo (yamo_spawn_timer from yamo_respawn_delay[room]), X = 2 Ninja (ninja_spawn_timer from ninja_respawn_delay[room]), other X both. The same halving/shortening rules as update_yamo_spawn apply. Called by remove_actor_restart_timer and by change_room (X = 0).

- **Called from:** [`take_exit2`](background_touch.md#take_exit2) [`$2FC6`](../../../src/background_touch.asm#L261), [`remove_actor`](touch_effects.md#remove_actor) [`$3048`](../../../src/touch_effects.asm#L72)
- **Jumps to:** [`reset_spawn_timer_check_ninja`](actor_spawn.md#reset_spawn_timer_check_ninja)

<a id="update_ninja_spawn"></a>
### [`update_ninja_spawn`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L355) `$0DB1`

*routine*

Ninja spawn timer (main loop). When ninja_spawn_timer is zero and the Ninja is not active: spawn the Ninja and load the next delay from ninja_respawn_delay[room], with the same halving/shortening rules as Yamo. While a computer Yamo is active, in the first game loop and before 6400 frames in the room, the Ninja waits $10 more passes when random_byte gives $19 or more (about 9 times in 10).

- **Called from:** [`main_loop`](game_main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1BFB`](../../../src/game_main_loop.asm#L50)
- **Calls:** [`get_room_time_level`](game_setup.md#get_room_time_level), [`random_byte`](interrupt_entry.md#random_byte), [`spawn_ninja`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_ninja)
- **Jumps to:** [`ninja_timer_short`](actor_spawn.md#ninja_timer_short)
- **Reads:** [`ninja_spawn_timer`](../memory-map.md#ninja_spawn_timer), [`actor_flags+1`](../memory-map.md#actor_flags), [`game_loop_count`](../memory-map.md#game_loop_count), [`option_yamo_player2`](options_and_patterns.md#option_yamo_player2), [`actor_flags+2`](../memory-map.md#actor_flags), [`room`](../memory-map.md#room)
- **Writes:** [`ninja_spawn_timer`](../memory-map.md#ninja_spawn_timer)
- **Refers to:** [`actor_flags`](../memory-map.md#actor_flags), [`ninja_respawn_delay`](room_enemy_tables.md#ninja_respawn_delay)

<a id="spawn_ninja"></a>
### [`spawn_ninja`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L398) `$0DF8`

*routine*

Spawn the Ninja (actor 2, type $40). Input: X = 2. Plays the entry sound, calls spawn_actor, sets actor_frame_a = $82 and actor_pose_b = actor_frame_b = 0 (no second sprite), actor_energy at most 7, actor_timer = $10, then turns him toward Bruce (measure_distance_to_bruce, face_bruce).

- **Called from:** [`update_ninja_spawn`](actor_spawn.md#update_ninja_spawn) [`$0DDF`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L381)
- **Calls:** [`play_enemy_spawn_sound`](game_setup.md#play_enemy_spawn_sound), [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor), [`measure_distance_to_bruce`](actor_helpers.md#measure_distance_to_bruce), [`face_bruce`](actor_helpers.md#face_bruce)
- **Refers to:** [`actor_frame_a`](../memory-map.md#actor_frame_a), [`actor_frame_b`](../memory-map.md#actor_frame_b)

<a id="set_sprite_slot_owner"></a>
### [`set_sprite_slot_owner`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L420) `$0E21`

*routine*

Record actor X as the owner of a hardware sprite. Input: A = collision code 3-7, X = actor. The sprite is collision_code_to_sprite[A-3] (code 3 -> sprite 4, codes 4-7 -> sprites 0-3); sprite_owner[sprite] = X. Output: Y = sprite. Called by spawn_actor and by remove_actor (to find the sprite that it frees).

- **Called from:** [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0B9F`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L31), [`spawn_actor`](actor_spawn.md#spawn_actor) [`$0BAB`](../../../src/actor_spawn.asm#L36), [`remove_actor`](touch_effects.md#remove_actor) [`$3027`](../../../src/touch_effects.asm#L55), [`remove_actor`](touch_effects.md#remove_actor) [`$3033`](../../../src/touch_effects.asm#L61)
- **Refers to:** [`collision_code_to_sprite`](actor_frame_tables.md#collision_code_to_sprite), [`sprite_owner`](../memory-map.md#sprite_owner)
